bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$db" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 71
docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tA -F: -c "
SELECT board_key,count(*) FILTER (WHERE enabled AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL AND message_thread_id > 0) AS verified,
count(*) AS total
FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND board_key IN ('area_bbs','video_chat','gay_board')
GROUP BY board_key ORDER BY board_key;" || exit 72
echo PROFILE_ROUTING_DB_READ_PASS
